## Purpose and Distribution Model
This repository is a read-only, community-plugin marketplace mirror for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Its root marketplace manifest is the installation entry point: `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Plugin changes originate from Anthropic’s review pipeline rather than direct PRs.

## Plugin Packaging Boundary
Each plugin is self-contained beneath a top-level directory, with Claude-recognized metadata defining its installable surface. Examples: `eli5/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `quickdesign/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, and `testdino/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. Per-plugin marketplace manifests exist where plugins expose a nested marketplace, e.g. `quickdesign/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.

## Claude Skill Runtime Content
Most plugin behavior is declarative instruction content executed by Claude as skills, rather than an application server. `SKILL.md` files are the operative entry points after installation: `eli5/skills/eli5/SKILL.md`, `quickdesign/skills/quickdesign/SKILL.md`, and `testdino/skills/testdino-audit/SKILL.md`. Supporting reference/model/pipeline documents constrain domain workflows and output quality.

## Domain Plugin Families
Quickdesign supplies AI video/design guidance, including model-specific and production-pipeline knowledge in `quickdesign/skills/quickdesign/models/` and `quickdesign/skills/quickdesign/pipelines/ugc-video.md`. Testdino exposes operational skills for testing, sessions, releases, and runs under `testdino/skills/`. Tres Finance is the largest domain package, organizing accounting, reconciliation, reporting, transaction, and ERP workflows under `tres-finance-plugin/skills/`.

## MCP and Executable Extensions
Some plugins declare Model Context Protocol integration through local MCP manifests, creating a boundary between Claude skill instructions and external tools/services: `testdino/.mcp.json` and `tres-finance-plugin/.mcp.json`. A limited subset includes Python automation invoked by skills, such as swap repricing at `tres-finance-plugin/skills/tres-asc845-swap-reprice-skill/scripts/orchestrate_reprice.py` and report analysis at `tres-finance-plugin/skills/tres-report-analyzer/scripts/analyze_report.py`.

## Marketplace Governance and CI
GitHub Actions enforce marketplace integrity and lifecycle controls. The primary validation workflow, `.github/workflows/validate-plugins.yml`, invokes the composite validator at `.github/actions/validate-plugins/action.yml`, which detects changed plugins, validates metadata/invariants, and checks CLI installation modes. Plugin security/pinning review is handled by `.github/actions/scan-plugins/action.yml`; pinned external references can be refreshed through `.github/workflows/bump-plugin-shas.yml`.

## Ownership and Change Control
External PRs are automatically closed via `.github/workflows/close-external-prs.yml`, preserving the mirror-only boundary. Ownership health is periodically checked through `.github/workflows/owner-liveness-sweep.yml` against `.github/owner-baseline.json`. The effective flow is: reviewed internal submission → nightly manifest/plugin sync → CI validation and security scanning → installable Claude marketplace entries.
